title: Under the Bed
subtitle: Henry follows Leo into the coziest hiding place.

levels.title: The Noise Upstairs
levels.clue: A sudden thump sends Leo—and Henry's ladybug—under the bed.

levels.title: Dust Under the Bed
levels.clue: Clear the soft dust bunnies so Henry can crawl underneath.

levels.title: Henry Squeezes In
levels.clue: Match beside the glowing pawstep to guide Henry toward Leo.

levels.title: Between the Slippers
levels.clue: Follow the pawprints around the slippers and boxes.

levels.title: The Sock Fort
levels.clue: Two layers of fluff stand between the brothers.

levels.title: Follow My Pawsteps
levels.clue: Henry keeps crawling, one gentle pawstep at a time.

levels.title: The Ladybug Clue
levels.clue: Henry spots a flash of red beside Leo's fluffy paw.

levels.title: Almost There, Leo
levels.clue: Only a few more careful pawsteps to reach Leo.

levels.title: A Gentle Wake-Up
levels.clue: A few quiet woofs let Leo know Henry is close.

levels.title: Out From Under
levels.clue: Guide Henry all the way to Leo, then bring the ladybug into the light.
